summary_en: A cooking tutorial video begins with displaying fresh ingredients before two chefs introduce fried beef patties, prep potatoes, and sauté onions. Next, ingredients are mixed, shaped into balls, breaded, fried in oil, and a sauce is prepared. Finally, the dish is elegantly plated on a black dish with microgreens and cherry tomatoes, drizzled with sauce, and concludes with the chefs wishing the audience a good meal.
